newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan starts bank's privatisation process.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan starts bank's privatisation process.

text.p: Pakistan's Privatisation Commission initiated the sale process of the state-owned First Women Bank Ltd on Thursday by inviting firms to apply for a 51 percent stake or 10.2 million shares, a government statement said.
It said firms should write by August 21 to the Privatisation Commission with a brief investor profile for their interest in the bank, which has been operating since 1989.
The First Women Bank has 38 branches, with deposits of 2.32 billion rupees and advances of 406 million rupees in December 1996, the statement said.
